subject: Re: NovaCorp private offer — evidence scope, term length & approver list
messages:
From: Alice Liu <alice.liu@novacorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Evans <michael.evans@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2028-12-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request — term/approval checklist

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers and the model routing options. Procurement asked me to capture a short list of outstanding items before we take the private offer to our CFO: 

- Confirm minimum contract term options you can support (12 / 24 / 36 months) and whether usage-only activation is available for pilots.
- A short evidence pack for security/compliance: SOC2 cert date, data retention controls, and where audit logs will be delivered.
- Who needs to sign from our side (we expect a procurement signer + IT security approver + CFO).
- A copy of the SOW with milestones for the pilot and post-pilot handoff.

Can you send a version of the offer that matches a 12-month pilot with an option to extend to a 36-month committed plan, and include the evidence checklist? Attaching the procurement template so you can see their standard fields.

Thanks,
Alice
--
Alice Liu
Head of Cloud Procurement, NovaCorp
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — term/approval checklist

Hi Alice — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline, and attaching the SOW and our evidence checklist for procurement review.

- Term options: We can do 12-month pilot (usage-billed, no commitment) OR 12/24/36-month committed private offers. For committed plans we typically lock price and unit rates for the term; we can include an auto-extension clause or an explicit renewal signature.
- Pilot activation: we support a usage-only pilot activated via a short PPO that gives access to a dedicated listing and quota. Pilot can convert to committed plan with pro-rated credits.
- Evidence pack: SOC 2 report (redacted), data retention/region controls, audit log export format (S3 delivery + CloudTrail integration) included in the attached checklist.
- Approver mapping: procurement + IT security + CFO is standard. For activation we require procurement signature and the security approver to confirm evidence receipt; CFO can sign at purchase for committed offers.

Attachments: NovaCorp_SOW_v2.pdf; evidence_package_checklist.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) I send a private offer draft for 12-month pilot (usage) and a parallel 36-month committed offer (price-locked), with a clear conversion path.
2) If you want, we can pre-populate the approver fields in the private offer metadata (procurement, security, CFO) so AWS Marketplace shows activation gating.
3) Jordan from Legal will confirm the SOW language around data handling and the conversion credit.

Jordan/Vivek — tagging you because this will need the activation gating metadata and legal on the SOW.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-09T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — term/approval checklist

Chloe / Vivek — I reviewed the SOW and evidence checklist. A few legal/ops notes before we send the private offers:

1) Data retention: we'll offer region-specific retention controls (90/180/365 days) in the SOW appendix; NovaCorp should pick one. Be explicit that logs are exported to NovaCorp S3 via a customer-owned bucket — include the CloudTrail delivery steps.
2) Conversion credit: if they convert from a 12-month usage pilot to a committed 36-month contract within 60 days of pilot end, we can apply a credit equal to the pilot usage up to $X (we'll set the cap). Need Chloe to confirm approximate pilot budget so we can set the cap.
3) Approver gating: Ops can require procurement + security approver on the Marketplace private offer metadata. If they want CFO signature required for activation, that increases activation latency; suggest procurement + security for activation, CFO for full purchase.
4) Signature flow: we should send the 12-month pilot as a non-committed private offer with explicit conversion TOC, and the 36-month committed as a separate private offer (DocuSign link in final email).

I can draft the conversion clause and the SOW appendix. Chloe — can you confirm expected pilot consumption (monthly spend estimate)? Vivek — will you weigh in on pricing band for 36-month locked term?

-Jordan
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-09T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — term/approval checklist

Thanks — I'm OK with the approach. Quick pricing guidance for the 36-month committed offer: 

- Baseline: $0.12/token-unit equivalent (on the shared model profile) for 12-month committed.
- 36-month locked: we can offer a 22% effective discount vs baseline, with an additional 3% for a minimum ARR threshold of $250k.
- Pilot: no commitment, pay-as-you-go at baseline + 15% pilot uplift to cover setup & reserved capacity. If they convert, the uplift is credited back up to the conversion cap Jordan will propose.

Chloe — for the conversion cap, assume a pilot monthly run-rate of $18k (based on their stated usage in the demo). That would suggest a conversion credit cap of $36k. If NovaCorp confirms a different estimate, we can adjust.

I'll prepare the pricing lines for both private offers and attach an example price sheet.

-Vivek
VP, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-09T17:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — term/approval checklist

Alice — thanks, sending the package below and a proposed next step timeline. Summary below and attachments included.

Summary (fast):
- 12-month pilot (usage-only): immediate private offer; pay-as-you-go at baseline + 15% pilot uplift. Pilot can be converted to committed plan; conversion credit cap: $36,000 (based on $18k/mo estimate).
- 36-month committed private offer: 22% discount off baseline, +3% if NovaCorp hits $250k ARR minimum. Price lock and quota reservation.
- Activation gating: set to Procurement + IT Security for Marketplace activation. CFO signature required only at purchase for committed offer (to avoid activation delay).
- Evidence: SOC 2 (redacted), data retention appendix (90/180/365 choice), audit log delivery (S3 + CloudTrail).

Attachments: NovaCorp_SOW_v2.pdf; evidence_package_checklist.xlsx; price_sheet_novacorp_example.xlsx (attached inline).

Next steps:
1) If this sounds good, confirm pilot budget estimate (is $18k/mo accurate?).
2) Confirm preferred retention period (90/180/365).
3) We will populate approver fields and send the two private offers in parallel (pilot + committed). Once procurement + security click activate for pilot, the sandbox access will provision within 24 hours.

If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk Procurement & Security through the evidence pack and the activation gating.

Thanks — Chloe

---
Attachments referenced: NovaCorp_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW, 6 pages), evidence_package_checklist.xlsx (manifest), price_sheet_novacorp_example.xlsx (pricing lines)
